name: Amanda (2010 Games)

origin.summary: An event from the 2010 CrossFit Games. The CrossFit Games are the season's final championship stage, where the qualified field competes across multiple events to crown the Fittest on Earth. Games events are tests first and workouts second — many use loads, formats, or venues no affiliate would program, which is exactly why they make interesting benchmarks.

description: A descending 9-7-5 couplet of ring muscle-ups and squat snatches — the classic Girl WOD Amanda, reused as a Games event.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2010/1 (official CrossFit Games event, individual division), retrieved 2026-07-10; the classic Girl WOD Amanda, reused as a Games event.
